title: Recovering Riemannian Geometry from Diffusion
summary: We present an intrinsic reconstruction of Riemannian geometry from a symmetric, strongly local diffusion semigroup. Starting from a diffusion operator and its associated first- and second-order diffusion calculus, we recover the full weighted Riemannian structure of the underlying manifold. In particular, we show that the carre du champ determines a unique smooth Riemannian metric, that the iterated carre du champ encodes curvature, and that the symmetry of the diffusion fixes the Levi-Civita connection and reference measure.
